content: The date of your first independent long-distance trip (or trip abroad)? (e.g., 20120601)
The year/month/day you acquired your first phone or computer? (e.g., 20100615)
An anniversary that means a lot to you but cannot be found on social media? (e.g., 20080912)
The date (year/month/day) you received your first formal salary? (e.g., 20150710)
The exact birthday of your best childhood friend? (e.g., 19980324)
The date of your first hotel stay or long-distance move? (e.g., 20110818)
The most special age reached by one of your parents or elders (with the year)? (e.g., 103+2015)
The approximate date (year/month/day) you first learned to swim, ride a bike, or master a skill? (e.g., 20040716)
The house number of an old house you once lived in (padded to 8 digits)? (e.g., 00001234)
The release/publication date of your favorite movie or book? (e.g., 19971219)
What was the landline number (with area code) of the home where you spent your childhood? (e.g., 010+87654321)
What are the first 8 digits of the first line on page 100 of your favorite book (if any)? (e.g., 23071968)
What is the full number of the parcel locker / pickup point you use most often? (e.g., 0317485269)
What was the employee ID you received when you first started work (pad with leading zeros to 8 digits if shorter)? (e.g., 00004567)
What digit sequence do you get when typing your favorite poem or song using the T9 keypad? (e.g., 54649374)
Your alma mater's (university) founding anniversary date plus the last few digits of your student ID? (e.g., 20100520+386)
The birth date (with year) of the celebrity or idol you admire most? (e.g., 19690811)
The phone number of the first contact (non-relative) in your phone's contact list? (e.g., 13912345678)
The combined date and time (year/month/day hour:minute:second) of a secret anniversary only you know (e.g., first meeting, confession)? (e.g., 20120601 18:30:05)
A landline number (with area code) you remember most vividly from childhood, with the year you graduated from elementary school appended at the end? (e.g., 0108765432+2006)
If you were to text yourself 20 years from now, what is your preset 6-digit verification code plus your desired height (in cm)? (e.g., 999886+190)
The exact amount of your first salary (in cents), plus what you ate for your first meal after receiving it? (e.g., 350000+Malatang)
The last 4 digits of your first phone number, plus the color and brand of that phone? (e.g., 5678+Silver Nokia)
The year and month of your first solo train ride or flight, plus the name of the destination city? (e.g., 201206+Chengdu)
The name of your childhood secret base, plus roughly how far it was from your home (in meters)? (e.g., Back Hill Bunker+500)
The name of the thickest book on your bookshelf, plus its position counting from left to right? (e.g., Modern Chinese Dictionary+5)
The first alarm time you set every morning, plus the first thing you do after waking up? (e.g., 0715+open the curtains)
The size and color of the shoes you wear most often, plus which shelf level (counting from the top) they sit on? (e.g., 37+Red+3)
A digit fragment from the ID of your first anonymous social account, plus a description of your avatar at the time? (e.g., 789+Cat on black background)
The last 4 digits of your admission ticket number for an important exam (high school / college / graduate entrance exam), plus a description of your exam room location? (e.g., 8015+Red Building 3)
The pinyin initials of your third-grade desk mate's name? (e.g., LXY)
The "secret nickname" you gave your most cherished childhood toy? (e.g., xiaohei)
A "secret code phrase" that only you and a particular best friend understand? (e.g., XOXO)
A unique symbol you often engrave on easy-to-lose items like umbrellas or water bottles, plus the color of the item? (e.g., Triangle+Fluorescent Green)
The pinyin of the vegetable or food you dislike the most? (e.g., kugua)
The abbreviation of the street name near your childhood home? (e.g., JFL)
The nickname of your first pet (or the animal you most want to own)? (e.g., Mimi)
If you were to give yourself a spy code name, what would it be? (e.g., NightFox)
The "nickname" classmates gave your favorite teacher behind their back? (e.g., yanjing)
A remote place you have been to but never mentioned again? (e.g., Qingxi)
The English abbreviation of the most eye-catching building (e.g., skyscraper, hotel) you pass on your daily commute? (e.g., ICC)
The first three letters of a professional term or software you use most often (e.g., Python, CAD, SAP)? (e.g., PYT)
The first two letters of the English name your first English teacher gave you (or the first English name you gave yourself)? (e.g., Al)
The pinyin/English initials of your current job title or position? (e.g., PM)
The combination of the brand name and model initials of an electronic device you frequently operate? (e.g., MacPro)
The pinyin initials of the beverage you drink most often (e.g., Coca-Cola)? (e.g., KKKL)
The pinyin initials of the name of your first mentor or honored teacher? (e.g., LCF)
The abbreviation of the skill or equipment you use most often in games? (e.g., AK)
The name of the mountain or island where you would most like to live in seclusion? (e.g., Penglai)
Where did you first see the sea? (e.g., Sanya)
The location of your first live concert or theater performance? (e.g., Beijing)
The first scenic spot you visited on your high school graduation trip? (e.g., Huangshan)
If you could own a fantasy creature as a mount, what would it be called? (e.g., Pegasus)
The name of your favorite niche song that only you listen to often? (e.g., Hush)
Which historical figure or scientist do you admire the most? (e.g., Sunzi)
The name of the distant planet you most want to visit but have not yet? (e.g., Mars)
A specific food you crave the most when you are under stress? (e.g., Pizza)
Which two seemingly unrelated words sound most harmonious when combined, in your opinion? (e.g., Marble and Cotton Candy)
If you could define a new color, what name would you give it? (e.g., Twilight Purple)
What completely harmless object were you most afraid of during your childhood? (e.g., The peephole of an old wooden door)
The pinyin of your first love's surname plus a punctuation mark you like most? (e.g., Zhang?)
Your college dormitory number joined with the @ symbol? (e.g., 5@106)
The first pinyin letter of your name plus your lucky number and an exclamation mark? (e.g., L7!)
Pick two "combo punctuation marks" you love to use at the end of messages? (e.g., ??)
Pick two symbols that represent "money" or "value"? (e.g., $$)
The amount of your first bonus, with a comma or period manually typed at the thousands place, plus the currency abbreviation? (e.g., $1,200)
The pinyin initials of your favorite catchphrase plus a question mark? (e.g., ZDL?)
Two asterisks "**" with your two favorite digits in between? (e.g., *42*)
A greater-than sign ">" plus the abbreviation of your dream city? (e.g., >SH)
The domain suffix of the email address you commonly use? (e.g., @gmail)
The abbreviation of your hometown and your current residence, joined with "~"? (e.g., JS~BJ)
Your favorite movie and its year, joined with a hyphen "-", with square brackets "[]" around the year? (e.g., Crisis-[2024])
The brand and color of your first bicycle, joined with an underscore "_", with "!" at the end? (e.g., Feiyue_Black!)
Your ideal vacation destination and year, joined with a plus "+", with the whole thing wrapped in parentheses "()"? (e.g., (Sanya+2026))
Your favorite band and their founding year, joined with a tilde "~"? (e.g., Coldplay~1998)
Your favorite dish and its main spice level, joined with an equals sign "="? (e.g., Mapo Tofu=5)
The brand of your first phone and the year you bought it, joined with an asterisk "*"? (e.g., Xiaomi*2023)
The pinyin abbreviation of the first dish you learned to cook and its difficulty rating (1-5 stars), joined with a hyphen "-"? (e.g., SCJD-4)
The country of your first trip abroad and the year, joined with an arrow "->"? (e.g., Thailand->2015)
Your "online nickname" plus the year you created it, wrapped in curly braces "{}"? (e.g., {Phoenix2020})
The train number of your first solo trip joined with "-" and the date digits of your departure? (e.g., G102-20150715)
A fragment of a math or physics formula you remember best from your school days, which must include its symbols? (e.g., E=mc^2 or a+b>c)
Describe an action with an arrow "->" between the steps, plus the target object? (e.g., push->wooden door)
Choose a favorite four-character phrase and insert an asterisk between each character? (e.g., Shang*Shan*Ruo*Shui)
The length and width of your first bedroom, joined with "*", plus the color? (e.g., 4*5 White)
Type a symbol pair you find most comfortable, with the pinyin of your first love's surname in the middle? (e.g., [zhang] or {li})
The first letter of your birth city, plus a "*" symbol, plus the floor number of your childhood home? (e.g., SH*12)
A favorite two-character word with "!" in the middle or at the end, plus a two-digit number? (e.g., Fight!88)
A currency symbol you wish you had (e.g., $, ¥, €), plus an ideal number you have in mind? (e.g., $88888888)
Wrap the first two characters of your first online nickname in < >, with the registration year after it? (e.g., <Breeze>2003)
